clips.title: The story
paras: Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp seeks a powerful gem known as the Mind's Eye, an artifact essential for rescuing young Yenniku. The stone rests in the hands of the formidable ogre spellcaster Mai'Zoth, who dwells deep within the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.

Following the recovery of the singing crystals, Kin'weelay turns his attention toward securing the Mind's Eye. This potent artifact is the solitary instrument capable of aiding the rescue of Yenniku, the son of the Darkspear chieftain. However, the stone is currently held by Mai'Zoth, a ruthless ogre mage whose presence Kin'weelay remembers from the tribe's earlier days in the jungle.

Mai'Zoth resides deep inside the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound to the east of Grom'gol. His magical prowess was formidable even before acquiring the Mind's Eye, and the stone has only amplified his strength. Confronting him amidst the ogre stronghold is fraught with peril, but wresting the artifact from his grasp remains the sole hope of freeing the young troll.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, east of here and deep within the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound. His name is Mai'Zoth. I know him from when the Darkspears dwelt in Stranglethorn - he is vicious, and his magic is strong.
And if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.
You must face Mai'Zoth and wrest from him the Mind's Eye. It is a perilous task, but it is the only hope we have of saving Yenniku.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, friend. The spirits sing praise of your bravery, yet they tell me no tales of your quest against Mai'Zoth.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You retrieved the eye! Your might is the stuff of legends, friend!
And in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether. That is why the spirits would not mention him before.
It is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...I fear he will begin a new reign.
But that is a worry for another time. Now, I must perform a ritual to bend the Mind's Eye to our needs...
